Counsel for Respondent :- Anjali Upadhya,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1. On oral prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioners, he is permitted to correct the
description of respondent no. 2 and also to implead Tehsildar as respondent no. 4 to the instant
petition.

2.  The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to mutate the names of the petitioners over Arazi No. 119 area 0.8640, 277 area 1.8010 and 279,
Village Makauda, Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Buddh Nagar, and to decide the representation of Prem Chandra And 2 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77980178/

sentences.text: the petitioners filed in this regard.
3. The case of the petitioners is that the aforesaid land of the petitioners was initially subjected to acquisition under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The acquisition proceedings were quashed by the Supreme Court and consequently, the names of the petitioners have to be restored in the revenue records.
A communication dated 08.10.2013 was sent in this behalf by ADM (Land Acquisition) Greater Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar to Tehsildar Sadar.
However, names of the petitioners have not been mutated so far.

4. On query made by the Court as to whether the petitioners have approached the Tehsildar to give effect to the communication dated 08.10.2013, learned counsel for the petitioners prays for withdrawal of the writ petition with liberty to the petitioners to approach the Tehsildar for mutation of their names in compliance of communication dated 08.10.2013.

5. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to file appropriate application in this behalf before the Tehsildar, and in which event the Tehsildar will pass a speaking order within four weeks.

The Tehsildar, before passing the order, will ascertain whether any compensation has been received by the petitioners and in which event any order for mutation of their names would only be passed subject to the petitioners refunding the compensation amount.
(Anish Kumar Gupta, J.)(Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 9.12.2024
